extName.description: Extension name shown in the browser and the Web Store.

extDescription.message: Create valid QR codes for links, text and Wi-Fi networks, then copy or save them as PNG or SVG. Everything stays on your device.
extDescription.description: Extension description. Keep it at 132 characters or fewer (Web Store limit).

commandOpen.description: Description of the keyboard shortcut that opens the popup.

settingsButtonTitle.description: Tooltip and accessible name of the settings button.

previewLabel.description: Accessible name of the section that shows the QR code.

qrAlt.description: Accessible name of the QR code image.

previewEmpty.message: Fill in the fields to see the QR code.
previewEmpty.description: Shown in place of the QR code while there is nothing to encode.

qrInfo.description: Technical summary under the QR code. The version is the QR code version (1 to 40); the size is the number of modules (squares) per side.

copyImage.description: Button that copies the QR code image to the clipboard.

savePng.description: Button that downloads the QR code as a PNG image.

saveSvg.description: Button that downloads the QR code as an SVG (vector) image.

tabsLabel.description: Accessible name of the tabs that choose what the QR code contains.

linkLabel.description: Label of the field for the link.

linkUsePage.description: Button that fills the link field with the address of the open page.

linkUsePageTitle.message: Fill in the address of the page you are on
linkUsePageTitle.description: Tooltip of the Use current page button.

linkHint.message: Addresses without http:// or https:// get https:// added.

wifiNameLabel.description: Label of the Wi-Fi network name field. SSID is the technical name of a Wi-Fi network.

wifiPasswordLabel.description: Label of the Wi-Fi password field.

wifiSecurityLabel.description: Label of the Wi-Fi security type selector.

wifiSecurityWpa.description: Wi-Fi security choice. Keep the protocol names.

wifiSecurityWep.description: Wi-Fi security choice. Keep the protocol name.

wifiSecurityNone.description: Wi-Fi security choice for a network without a password.

wifiHidden.description: Checkbox for a Wi-Fi network that does not broadcast its name.

showPassword.description: Button that reveals the typed password.

hidePassword.description: Button that masks the typed password again.

optionsLabel.description: Accessible name of the options section.

errorCorrectionLabel.description: Label of the selector for how much of the QR code may be damaged and still scan.

ecLow.description: Error correction choice. The percentage is how much of the code can be damaged.

exportSizeLabel.description: Label of the selector for the size of saved and copied PNG images.

footer.message: QR codes are generated on your device. Nothing is sent anywhere.

settingsBack.description: Button that leaves the settings view.

rememberLabel.message: Remember what I typed while the browser is open
rememberLabel.description: Checkbox that keeps the typed fields between popup openings.

rememberHint.message: Kept in browser memory only, Wi-Fi password included, and erased when Chrome closes. Turning this off deletes it now.
rememberHint.description: Privacy note shown below the remember checkbox.

statusCleared.description: Status shown after the fields were emptied.

statusCopyFailed.message: Could not copy the image. Save it as a file instead.
statusCopyFailed.description: Status shown when copying to the clipboard failed.

statusSaved.description: Status shown after a file download started.

statusSaveFailed.description: Status shown when the settings could not be stored.

statusUsePageFailed.message: Could not read the address of this page.
statusUsePageFailed.description: Status shown when the address of the open page is unavailable, for example on a browser page.

errorInvalidUrl.message: Enter a valid web address, such as example.com.
errorInvalidUrl.description: Error shown when the link is not a web address.

errorSsidTooLong.message: The network name can have at most $BYTES$ bytes.
errorSsidTooLong.description: Error shown when the Wi-Fi name is too long.

errorPasswordRequired.description: Error shown when a secured Wi-Fi network has no password.

errorPasswordLength.message: A WPA password has $MIN$ to $MAX$ characters.
errorPasswordLength.description: Error shown when the Wi-Fi password length is not allowed.

errorTooLong.message: Too much data. At most $BYTES$ bytes fit at this error correction level.
errorTooLong.description: Error shown when the content does not fit in any QR code.

errorGeneric.message: Something went wrong. Please try again.
